result: At the pinned rust-sdk commit, RequestMetaObject is serde-transparent over MetaObject, which is serde-transparent over JsonObject. request_meta() borrows the RequestMetaObject raw map from Extensions. Serialize for Request<M,R> passes that map into WithMeta, whose serializer emits one params._meta object and copies the raw map entries into it. If typed params also contain _meta, the serializer merges them and extensions-level RequestMetaObject entries overwrite conflicting params-level keys. Therefore protocol_version, client_info, and client_capabilities previously injected into RequestMetaObject are serialized as their stored JSON keys/values into params._meta by the request serializer, with no source-level key rename or value rewrite in this path.
